units.source_text: 不知何时，他早已想好了回复“假如尸体不足，我就会没有任何恶意地去杀人。”

en.t: At some point, he had already thought of his reply: "If there are not enough corpses, I will kill people without the slightest malice."

units.source_text: 可是毫无疑问他只把这话放在心里。

en.t: But without a doubt, he kept those words only in his heart.
